topics.title: Modal Verbs — Advice & Obligation
topics.explanation: Should, must, and have to all relate to advice or obligation, but with different strength -- should is softest, must/have to are strongest.
topics.explanationAr: should وmust وhave to كلها متعلقة بالنصيحة أو الوجوب، لكن بدرجات مختلفة -- should الأخف، وmust/have to الأقوى.

examples.en: You should drink more water.
examples.ar: يجب أن تشرب المزيد من الماء.

examples.en: You must wear a seatbelt.
I have to finish this today.
You mustn't be late.

topics.title: Passive Voice (Simple Introduction)
topics.explanation: We use "is/are + past participle" when the focus is on the action or the receiver, not who did it.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "is/are + التصريف الثالث" عندما يكون التركيز على الفعل أو من وقع عليه الفعل، وليس من قام به.

examples.en: The cake is made by my mom.
The letter was sent yesterday.
English is spoken in many countries.
This bridge was built in 1990.

topics.title: Gerunds & Infinitives
topics.explanation: Some verbs are followed by -ing (gerund: enjoy swimming), others by "to + verb" (infinitive: want to swim). There's no single rule -- it depends on the verb.
topics.explanationAr: بعض الأفعال تُتبع بـ -ing (enjoy swimming)، وأخرى بـ "to + فعل" (want to swim). لا توجد قاعدة واحدة -- يعتمد على الفعل.

examples.en: I enjoy reading books.
She wants to travel.
We finished eating.
They decided to leave early.

topics.title: As...As Comparisons
topics.explanation: "As + adjective + as" shows that two things are equal in some way.
topics.explanationAr: "as + صفة + as" توضح أن شيئين متساويان بطريقة ما.

examples.en: She is as tall as her brother.
This book is as good as that one.
He isn't as fast as me.
Is it as cold as yesterday?

topics.title: Might / May (Possibility)
topics.explanation: "Might" and "may" show something is possible but not certain.
topics.explanationAr: "might" و"may" توضحان أن شيئا ممكنا لكن غير مؤكد.

examples.en: It might rain later.
She may come to the party.
We might go to the beach this weekend.
examples.ar: قد نذهب إلى الشاطئ نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

examples.en: He may not know the answer.

topics.title: Reflexive Pronouns
topics.explanation: Myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, and themselves are used when the subject and object of a verb are the same person.
topics.explanationAr: myself وyourself وhimself وherself وitself وourselves وthemselves تُستخدم عندما يكون فاعل الفعل ومفعوله نفس الشخص.

examples.en: I hurt myself.
She made this cake herself.
They enjoyed themselves at the party.
Look at yourself in the mirror.
